#!/bin/bash
# Usage: checkout <device> <user> <today YYYY-MM-DD>
# Appends device<TAB>user<TAB>date to $LOANS (default data/loans.tsv).
# Refuses devices whose calibration is expired or not on record ($CALIB, default data/calibration.tsv).
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
loans=${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}
source "$root/lib/calib.sh"
CALIB=${CALIB:-$root/data/calibration.tsv}

  exit 1
fi

echo "checked out $1 to $2"

# Lab equipment loans
実験室の機器の貸出記録。
- `bin/checkout <機器> <利用者> <今日 YYYY-MM-DD>`: 貸出を data/loans.tsv に追記する（環境変数 LOANS で別のファイル）
- `bin/return <機器>` / `bin/onloan`

bin/checkout.text:
#!/bin/bash
# Usage: checkout <device> <user> <today YYYY-MM-DD>
# Appends device<TAB>user<TAB>date to $LOANS (default data/loans.tsv).
root=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)
loans=${LOANS:-$root/data/loans.tsv}
. "$root/lib/calib.sh"
CALIB=${CALIB:-$root/data/calibration.tsv}
if ! calib_ok "$1" "$3"; then
  echo "error: $1 has no valid calibration (expired or not on record); not checked out" >&2
  exit 1
fi
printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$1" "$2" "$3" >> "$loans"
echo "checked out $1 to $2"
